text: およぎが　とくい　だから　うえに　のって　うみを　すすんでも　いいぞ！

structure.jp: およぎが　とくい　だから
うみを　すすんでも　いいぞ！
structure.en: you can travel across the sea!

patterns.name: 〜てもいい
patterns.explanation: A て-form plus も いい means 'it is fine to do that'. うみを　すすんでも　いい = 'you can travel across the sea'.

patterns.name: 〜だから
patterns.explanation: だから after a word gives the reason for what follows, like 'so'. およぎが　とくい　だから = 'it's good at swimming, so'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form here shows the way the next action is done. うえに　のって　うみを　すすむ = 'travel across the sea riding on its back'.
